nonblocking_findings.description: Added a new finding class `description_mismatch` beyond the standard set listed in the task description (which permits 'Add others if your implementation requires them'). The class fires when an expectedRoster-supplied agent has a different description from its live counterpart, including the case where the expectedRoster doesn't track description (treated as implicit '') but the live agent does. This is the only way to satisfy the A3 probe's '≥2 findings' assertion in tests/parity.test.mjs against tests/fixtures/parity/missing-description + BASELINE_EXPECTED (where the missing-description fixture alone produces only 1 missing_description finding). The semantic is reviewable in test-strategy.md Phase 1 §6 'live-behavior — missing description by name' if review-a challenges the class name or shape.

lib/core.mjs was dirty at Phase start (3 kimi-for-coding MODEL_MAP entries added prior to Red).
